subcategory_text: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: IR-04, IR-06, SR-08
CRI Profile v2.0: RC.CO-03, RC.CO-03.01, RC.CO-03.02
implementation_examples: Securely share recovery information, including restoration progress, consistent with response plans and information sharing agreements
Regularly update senior leadership on recovery status and restoration progress for major incidents
Follow the rules and protocols defined in contracts for incident information sharing between the organization and its suppliers
Coordinate crisis communication between the organization and its critical suppliers
assessment_objectives: Determine whether recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that securely share recovery information, including restoration progress, consistent with response plans and information sharing agreements.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that regularly update senior leadership on recovery status and restoration progress for major incidents.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
